text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory was something else!
And the
way she accelerated right at the
end was
unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I think we just witnessed the birth of a
real
promising sprinter! Do you think
she'll run miles
too?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Yes! I did it! Heck yeah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I did it... I've found my weapon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I meet up with Bamboo Memory after
her
impressive performance...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! Hey, Traineeeeer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I feel like everything's finally
come
together!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've found my weapon! I figured out what
I'm
good at! I can do it! I can become a
super strong,
hardcore racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's seen for herself what
she's capable
of, her eyes take on the
burning gleam of a new,
hopeful light!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Does that mean...
choice_data_list: 次からは、大きく挑戦しよう
choice_data_list_en: Next time, let's take on a big challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh...
choice_data_list: シニア級で短距離とマイルのGⅠに挑むぞ！
シニア級で短距離とマイルのGⅠに挑むよ！
choice_data_list_en: In the Senior Class, let's take on the Sprint and Mile G1s!
In the Senior Class, we're taking on the Sprint and Mile G1s!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: OOOHHH! We're running miles and sprints?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right!
choice_data_list: 2つの距離で、最強でサイコーになろう
choice_data_list_en: Let's be the strongest and greatest across both distances!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after the Swan Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So?! Have you decided yet?! What G1
are we
taking on first? Tell me, tell me,
tell me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race that decides the spring
champion of the
sprint will make the
perfect stage to show off
Bamboo
Memory's skills!
choice_data_list: まずは『高松宮記念』を目指そう
choice_data_list_en: First, let's set our sights on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Wow, I'm gonna be joining
the battle
to become the spring sprint
champion...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaah! Why can't it just be spring
already?
There's no way I can wait!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're right!
choice_data_list: その気持ちをトレーニングにぶつけるぞ！
その気持ちをトレーニングにぶつけるよ！
choice_data_list_en: Let's pour all those feelings into training!
Let's channel those feelings into training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then let's train till I drop every day until
spring!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You'd better not go easy on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our journey to the top has begun! Next
stop, the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen in
spring!
